# v3c (canonical-scale normalization) on dev + synthetic crops (generated by scripts/aggregate_v3c_dev.py)

Primary: crop-macro F1@0.50, BA-TOS_sel, seed-ignore (markers_dominant), no size filter.

At f = 0.7 / 1.4 / 2.0, v3c is scored on canonical field-of-view windows (native side round(200 r/10)); the v3 / fixflat numbers there are Phase 5e results on the 200³ synthetic windows: reference only, not the same windows. Boundary cost vs v3 exists only at f = 1.0 (same crops).

## Acceptance (docs/V3C_CANONICAL.md)

| f | n | v3c F1@0.50 | threshold | pass |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0.7 | 12 | 0.988 | 0.966 | True |
| 1 | 12 | 0.986 | 0.976 | True |
| 1.4 | 12 | 0.983 | 0.966 | True |
| 2 | 12 | 0.985 | 0.966 | True |
